adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, decrypted `keys` are handled as `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` with no `try/catch` or validation. If decryption produces non-JSON (wrong key, corrupted payload) `symmetricDecrypt` and/or `JSON.parse` will throw and Next.js will return a 500. Additionally, even when parsing succeeds, the resulting `keys` object is stored directly into `credential.key` via `prisma.credential.update/create` without any schema validation, so arbitrary/unexpected key shapes can be persisted. The `|| ""` fallback for the encryption key is present in the call site, and while `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` reduces reachability when the env var is truly unset/empty, malformed ciphertext or non-JSON plaintext is still unhandled and will 500.
